source.creator: jackroberts___
source.topic: Product pricing hierarchy and prompt interaction

inspection.method: Direct browser screenshots of selected muted playback frames during the variety review.
inspection.coverageNote: Two approximate observation points; product claims and exact asset origin were not independently verified.

observations.visibleEvidence: A white pricing/feature panel sits above the presenter on a saturated blue/cyan/purple stage. Large dark price typography dominates the smaller feature labels and button.
A compact black prompt-entry object has a blue/green iridescent rim, in front of a luminous white/cyan vertical bar and atmospheric blue-white glow.

principles: Visual hierarchy can center one source-backed product detail.
Lighting and material can distinguish a focused interaction from a pricing or feature display.
Different constructions can appear within the same split-screen format.
notes: See research/VARIETY_REVIEW.md for direct observations and interpretation.
